title: Bonfires EX
description: Addon for Bonfires with structures, compatibility, mechanics and improvements.
body:
Addon for the Bonfires mod.
# Features:
- Standalone structures in several dimensions and village jigsaws. Compatible with Vanilla, Choice Theorem's Overhauled Village, Towns and Towers and Terralith villages.
- EMI integration for general info and obscure item uses.
- Recipe balance changes.
- Antique Atlas 4 automatic landmark support.
- Modded Gliders added as loot in Bonfire Towers.
- Central End Island bonfire placement restriction.
- Bed spawn point disabled (Configurable).
- Bonfire screenshot resolution reduced to optimize storage.
- Experimental TPS boost when using the Travel Menu (Configurable).
- Added durability to Coiled Sword Fragment
- Increased Bonfire max name length to 24 characters (UI adjusted too)
- Probably other small improvements...

Visit the Galery to see more.

You can use a mod like Sparse Structures or Cristel Lib to configure structure distribution without datapacks.

By using the Global Packs mod, you can configure this mod via a datapack and have it enabled by default in all worlds.

To do:
- Estus Flask has display issues in the inventory when Eating Animations is installed

This addon is Fabric exclusive for the time being, I'll try to port it to NeoForge if it's worth it in the future.
Visit the GitHub repository to contribute and to report bugs.
